cities.name: Isidis Procyon
cities.intro: The 3D city is the InterImm martian-cities SketchUp model. Fly around it, walk its terraces under the Martian sun, then set a population and see what it takes to keep everyone alive.
cities.intro_cn: 三维城市来自星际移民中心的 martian-cities SketchUp 模型。你可以环绕飞行，在火星阳光下漫步它的梯田，再设定人口，看看要让所有人活下去需要多少资源。
